A envolvente dispõe ainda de espaços verdes, escola, transportes públicos e acesso à autoestrada, reunindo comércio, serviços e acessibilidades úteis nas rotinas diárias.

On the top floor, this 2-bedroom apartment for sale in Eiras, Coimbra, combines dual aspect, a balcony in every room and a garage for 1 vehicle. A property with outdoor spaces that extend the different areas of the home.

Situated on the 3rd floor of a building with 1 lift, the property is under construction and its condition is listed as excellent. It has a usable floor area of 83.2 m² m² and a gross floor area of 101 m² m².

The layout includes a bedroom with an en-suite bathroom and private balcony, a second bedroom with a wardrobe and access to a balcony, a living room and a fully equipped kitchen. The 2 bathrooms complement the apartment's layout, while the wardrobe provides practical storage for everyday use.

In terms of quality and comfort, it features controlled mechanical ventilation, a heat pump for heating water, air conditioning and double-glazed windows with a thermal break.

Located in Eiras and São Paulo de Frades, in a rapidly growing area, it benefits from being close to Mercadona, Continente, Eiras Retail Park, clinics and a pharmacy. The surrounding area also offers green spaces, a school, public transport and access to the motorway, bringing together shops, services and convenient transport links for daily routines.
